classes_checked.what_was_checked: Compared absence and unextracted-outcome rows with held abstracts, registry records and EMPA-KIDNEY full text; checked not_stated population metadata.
Checked primary and kidney-only HRs, intervals and contrast direction, plus EMPA-KIDNEY ketoacidosis count-derived RR and amputation HR.
Compared pooled primary and kidney-only estimates with their source endpoint clauses; checked harm counts and the disclosed differences between composite definitions.
Compared included populations and X2 exclusions with protocol eligibility and held trial titles and registry conditions.
Checked primary publication roles, PMID/NCT family assignments and pooled membership. Used the supplied abstract-integrity measurements.
Compared SMART-C reported outcome, estimates, scope qualifications and overlap assertions with its held abstract and comparator text.
Checked reason-code and unextracted-outcome audit keys and screening adjudications against the trials and outcomes they address.
Checked per-outcome endpoint definitions, follow-up fields and source identifiers; reproduced the harm endpoint-binding error with the current derivation function.

findings.title: Kidney-disease synonym omission excludes two dialysis trials

claim.quote: "decision": "exclude", "rule_id": "X2", "reason": "population not on-topic: title/conditions do not mention any of ['chronic kidney disease', 'kidney disease', 'CKD', 'nephropathy', 'chronic kidney diseases'] (an incidental abstract mention does not qualify)."

evidence.quote: "title": "Safety and Efficacy of Empagliflozin in Hemodialysis", "acronym": "SEED", "study_type": "INTERVENTIONAL", "allocation": "RANDOMIZED", "masking": "DOUBLE", "conditions": [ "End Stage Renal Disease" ]
"title": "Dapagliflozin Effect on Cardiovascular Outcomes in Haemodialysis for End Stage Renal Disease"
- **I2** - adult chronic kidney disease / kidney disease / diabetic nephropathy population, judged from title or registry conditions;
Eligibility is NOT on the outcome axis.

findings.why_wrong: The quoted exclusion is assigned to SEED (NCT05786443) and DECODED (NCT04764097). Their held records explicitly identify end-stage renal disease and dialysis. The screen mistakes missing vocabulary for an off-topic population. The protocol does not exclude dialysis populations; whether progression is an applicable endpoint belongs to extraction.
findings.served_effect: Both trials are removed from eligibility and registered-outcome coverage. This does not establish that either supplies a poolable progression estimate.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the two unchanged ctgov records and topic configuration as inputs to screen.screen_record. Assert both pass the population criterion and are not X2 exclusions. The current function reproduces X2 for both; recognize end-stage renal disease terminology while keeping outcome compatibility separate.

findings.title: Primary composite definition attached to both harm results

claim.quote: "endpoint_definition": "primary outcome was a composite of progression of kidney disease (defined as end-stage kidney disease, a sustained decrease in eGFR to <10 ml per minute per 1"

evidence.quote: Ketoacidosis occurred in 6 patients in the empagliflozin group versus 1 patient in the placebo group (0.09 versus 0.02 per 100 patient-years).
Lower limb amputations occurred in 28 patients in the empagliflozin group and 19 in the placebo group (0.43 versus 0.29 per 100 patient-years).

findings.why_wrong: This endpoint_definition appears on the EMPA-KIDNEY rows for both Diabetic ketoacidosis and Lower-limb amputation. The values describe those distinct safety outcomes, not the primary cardiorenal composite. compat_check._derive_endpoint selects the primary-outcome sentence without binding it to the requested outcome.
findings.served_effect: The JSON and rendered compatibility fields attach an unrelated endpoint to otherwise correctly extracted harm results.
findings.proposed_fixture: Pass each existing EMPA-KIDNEY harm row, its outcome specification and held PMID 36331190 record to compat_check._derive_endpoint. Assert the returned definition refers to the requested harm or is unresolved, and never starts with the primary cardiorenal definition. Both current calls reproduce the wrong definition.

findings.title: SMART-C kidney-only estimate stored under a cardiorenal outcome label

evidence.quote: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: CKD progression, defined as kidney failure, at least 50% reduction in eGFR, or death due to kidney failure.
SGLT2 inhibitors reduced the risk of CKD progression (25.4 vs 40.3 events per 1000 patient-years; hazard ratio [HR], 0.62 [95% CI, 0.57-0.68])

findings.why_wrong: The comparator.reported entry relabels SMART-C's kidney-only CKD progression estimate as the review's trial-defined primary cardiorenal composite. Separate scope and DIFFERENT_QUANTITY warnings correctly acknowledge the distinction but do not correct this structured outcome label.
findings.served_effect: Consumers of comparator.reported receive the correct number paired with the wrong endpoint identity.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the held PMID 41203232 abstract and current topic configuration to construct the comparator record. Assert that the 0.62 estimate retains the source CKD-progression endpoint and is not labelled Trial-defined primary cardiorenal composite; preserve the DIFFERENT_QUANTITY relation separately.

findings.title: EMPA-KIDNEY adult population marked not stated despite held full text

evidence.quote: At randomization, mean age was 63.8 years, 33% of participants were women and 54% did not have diabetes

findings.why_wrong: The EMPA-KIDNEY compatibility metadata reports population_age as not_stated. The held full text explicitly identifies adults and reports their mean age. The derivation inspects selected row text and the abstract without incorporating this held population section.
findings.served_effect: Population metadata remains falsely unresolved across the EMPA-KIDNEY outcome rows.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the existing PMID 36331190 record together with ft_36331190.txt in compatibility enrichment. Assert population_age is adult with a held supporting span for each EMPA-KIDNEY row, rather than not_stated. Keep the full-text input necessary so the test detects omission of held sources.

findings.title: Ketoacidosis provenance cites a PMCID inconsistent with the held article
findings.why_wrong: The ketoacidosis source description identifies the full text as PMC9761906, whereas the held article identifies itself as PMC7614055. The asserted source identifier does not match the document supplying the counts.
findings.served_effect: The displayed verification provenance directs readers to an identifier inconsistent with the held evidence.
findings.proposed_fixture: Parse the PMCID from the front matter of ft_36331190.txt and compare it with the PMCID in the generated ketoacidosis source description. Assert equality to PMC7614055; the current description contains PMC9761906.
